import inspect
from gunicorn.config import OnStarting

val = OnStarting.default
print('val:', val)
print('type(val):', type(val))

# Check what _signature_from_callable does
print()
print('Checking _signature_from_callable logic:')
print('hasattr(val, \"__call__\"):', hasattr(val, '__call__'))
print('callable(val):', callable(val))

# Check the __objclass__ attribute
print()
print('hasattr(val, \"__objclass__\"):', hasattr(val, '__objclass__'))
if hasattr(val, '__objclass__'):
    print('val.__objclass__:', val.__objclass__)

# Check if it's a method
print()
print('inspect.ismethod(val):', inspect.ismethod(val))
print('inspect.isfunction(val):', inspect.isfunction(val))
print('inspect.isbuiltin(val):', inspect.isbuiltin(val))
print('inspect.ismethoddescriptor(val):', inspect.ismethoddescriptor(val))
